name: brewpage
description: Prepare drafts, publish HTML, Markdown, JSON, files and static sites, and update BrewPage publications from Codex. Uses the connected BrewPage MCP server or the bundled HTTPS runner.

interface.shortDescription: Publish HTML, Markdown, files and sites to a shareable link
interface.longDescription: Prepare a local draft, share a finished artifact through BrewPage or update a specific publication. The plugin includes recipes for forms with saved visitor answers, custom domains and owner access. It uses BrewPage MCP when the available tools support the requested operation and the bundled HTTPS runner when permitted. Anonymous publishing needs no account or API key. Private management receipts go to the owner. BrewPage is a hosted, closed-source service. This plugin is MIT-licensed.
